provenance_limit: This design responds to external review after the primary and matched-64 results were known. It is a sensitivity analysis, not a preregistered confirmation.

matched_delta_null_description.support: one value from each of the 6,434 non-observed label-complement pairs
matched_delta_null_description.claim_limit: Describes the reference distribution; it does not estimate a population effect across new benchmark suites.

pca95_representation_vs_prompt64.representation_arm: existing selection-aware task-held-out probe with fold-local 95%-variance PCA
pca95_representation_vs_prompt64.site_policy: same unwhitened mean-shift site reselected for every balanced assignment
pca95_representation_vs_prompt64.disclosure: Numerical spot checks were seen before this manifest; the automated hash-gated summary is not predeclared evidence.
pca95_representation_vs_prompt64.claim_limit: The arms intentionally have unequal dimensions. This tests whether fixed activation width 64 created the matched-null result; it is not a capacity-matched comparison.

representation_width_sensitivity.classifier: same cuML QN logistic regression as the matched-64 analysis
representation_width_sensitivity.site_policy: same unwhitened mean-shift site reselected for every balanced assignment
primary_outputs: effective-null mean, standard deviation, and quantiles
representation_width_sensitivity.execution_gate: Run a bounded OLMo timing and convergence smoke before the raw-width exact analysis.
representation_width_sensitivity.claim_limit: Unequal-width arms are sensitivity analyses. Full width also changes the effective regularization of penalty_normalized=true.

inference_unit_contrast.partition: alphabetically first eight tasks versus the remaining eight
inference_unit_contrast.site: the unwhitened mean-shift-selected site for that assignment
inference_unit_contrast.classifier: same balanced logistic estimator as the matched analysis
inference_unit_contrast.valid_analysis: existing held-out-task score and exact task-label randomization
inference_unit_contrast.deliberately_naive_analysis: five-fold stratified random-example cross-validation with labels permuted over examples
inference_unit_contrast.claim_limit: This demonstrates the effect of changing the inferential unit on the same arbitrary partition. It is not a reproduction of Sahoo et al.'s model, datasets, or intervention study.

matched_delta_reselection_calibration.synthetic_site_policy: append an injected candidate site; never overwrite a real site
matched_delta_reselection_calibration.partition: alphabetically first eight tasks versus remaining eight
matched_delta_reselection_calibration.selection: append the synthetic site's exact mean-shift scores to the real-site score matrix and reselect for every assignment
matched_delta_reselection_calibration.statistic: selection-aware activation macro-F1 minus stored prompt64 macro-F1
matched_delta_reselection_calibration.decision_summary: detection fraction at p<0.01 with a Wilson interval
matched_delta_reselection_calibration.claim_limit: Ten directions give a coarse simulation sensitivity estimate. No 80% detection threshold is claimed unless its interval and direction count support it.

deferred.regularized_whitened_selector: requires a separately frozen regularization grid and numerical inversion audit
deferred.nested_probe_selected_site: millions of fits per model; not treated as a cheap reviewer-response analysis
deferred.correctness_conditioning: requires raw-response retention and parser repair for Apertus and Gemma
deferred.equivalence_bound: requires a scientifically chosen margin before interval inversion
